sections.indications:
Urinary antiseptic and astringent. 
 Leucorrhea and svetapradara. 
 Menorrhagia or Raktapradara. 
 Fever. 
 Anemia. 
 Poor appetite and assimilation. 

 Though this medicine is used primarily in female’s complication. But it is also useful in many other diseases like inflammatory conditions, low digestion power and anorexia. 
 Contradiction 

 If one have irregular prolonged cycle, then don’t take this medicine. 
 Very high dose may cause burning sensation. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Patrangasava – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Pradara Roga 122-126 
 It is an Ayurvedic medicine which is mainly used in the gynecological conditions such as heavy menstrual bleeding, leucorrhea and fever etc. This herbal product is prepared by the combination of various herbs which are quite beneficial to hormonal irregularities. Herbs like Patranga, Khadira, Vasa, Shalmalikusuma, Bala, Bhallataka, Sariva, Japakusuma, Amrasthi, Jeeraka, Bilva, etc are used in the preparation of Patrangasava.

 Indications

 Fever.

 Poor appetite and assimilation. 
 
 Though this medicine is used primarily in female’s complication. But it is also useful in many other diseases like inflammatory conditions, low digestion power and anorexia. 
 Contradiction 
 
 If one have irregular prolonged cycle, then don’t take this medicine. 
 Very high dose may cause burning sensation. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
